parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/RadioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the two methods — `radioPlayerStopCallsUnderlyingPlayer` (line 37) and `radioPlayerStopResetsStream` (line 53) — share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.818), they are distinct test cases verifying different observable behaviours of the stop action: one asserts delegation to the underlying player and the other asserts stream-reset side effects. Collapsing or deduplicating them would obscure test intent and reduce failure-message clarity, which is the primary value of granular test methods.
